top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori, Ye) are a concrete, experimentally checkable invention: the magic wavelength cancels the light shift while tight confinement removes Doppler and recoil shifts, and independent groups (Sr, Yb, Hg) reproduced 1e-18-level uncertainties with fibre-link comparisons. The two-name allocation covers the concept and the performance frontier without a gap. P001 is a close second, a mature and well-confirmed discovery, but its attribution (BHZ proposal behind the HgTe experiment, 3D work) remains less clean; no award is clearly worse than either.
recusal_note: No tie to Katori, Ye or their groups; my group works on slow-light laser stabilization in spectral-hole-burning crystals, a neighbouring technique but not shared work. No tie to Kane, Mele or Molenkamp.
